It does not execute code. msg = message_from_string(raw_email_text) # Extract sender email address from_header = msg.get("From", "") name, email_address = parseaddr(from_header) # Sanitize email_address to prevent CRLF injection if it were to be used in headers/logs final_email = email_address.replace('\n', '').replace('\r', '') if email_address else "" # Extract the body of the email to check for keywords content = [] # Use a limit on the number of parts to prevent "decompression bomb" style # multipart emails causing resource exhaustion parts_count = 0 for part in msg.walk(): parts_count += 1 if parts_count > 100: break content_type = part.get_content_type() if content_type == "text/plain": payload = part.get_payload(decode=True) if payload: content.append(payload.decode(errors="ignore")) elif content_type == "text/html": payload = part.get_payload(decode=True) if payload: content.append(payload.decode(errors="ignore")) full_text = " ".join(content).lower() # Decision logic: Using simple string containment (no regex used, avoiding ReDoS) should_unsubscribe = any(keyword in full_text for keyword in UNSUBSCRIBE_KEYWORDS) return UnsubscribeDecision( email=final_email, unsubscribe=should_unsubscribe ) except HTTPException as he: raise he except Exception as e: # Error handling: Catch all exceptions to prevent leaking stack traces # Log the error safely logger.error(f"Internal error processing request: {str(e)}") raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error") if __name__ == "__main__": # Run on 0.0.0.0:5000 as requested uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
